verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device AI SDK and model-hosting platform (Wally CLI and cloud), not itself an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair axis. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The SDK's tool calling, the OpenAI-compatible endpoint and the CLI integrations are adjacent features, not an MCP server agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
